Definition: from (the neuter of) G3588 and G3753; the when, i.e. at the time that (of the past or future, also in consecution):--that time, then.
BiblicalUsage: Then — the word that marks the time when everything changes. Judge nothing before the time, Paul says, until the Lord come, and then shall every man have praise of God; and when men say peace and safety, then sudden destruction comes upon them.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the word is a hinge: before then and after then are different worlds, and the whole of the Christian life is lived waiting for it.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
